law_record.title: Crossing sidewalk or sidewalk area
law_record.text: The operator of a bicycle, electric bicycle, or electric scooter within a business or residence district entering into or emerging from an alley, driveway or building shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway, driveway or building, yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian as may be necessary to avoid collision.

activation_conditions: the subject rides into or out of an alley, driveway or building
the location is a business or residence district
the machine is about to cross a sidewalk or sidewalk area
residue: 'business or residence district' is a legal region class — a reading assumption
unlike the equivalent driver rule, this one imposes no second yield on entering the roadway
summary.subject: rider

timing_requirements.requirement: the halt precedes the sidewalk, and the yield follows it
a full stop, judged by the drv.stopped parameters — a rolling approach is the violation
